methodsByLane.packages: line-oriented lexical scan over live in-scope package files
methodsByLane.apps-infra: ts-morph syntax-only exact CallExpression it.effect(...); excludes it.effect.prop(...) by expression identity

limitations: Exact it.effect( calls only; it.effect.prop( calls are excluded and counted separately.
Exact syntactic call identity; aliases and computed property access are not counted.
